M6.title: Alternative quadratic schedule
M6.validation: Informal construction check, not Lean-checked; existing definition and existence types support the scope.
M6.argument: For γ<1 choose integer M≥max(2,ceil(1/(1−γ))). Times M(k+1)^2 are infinite, exceed1 and are nonconsecutive. If r(m)≥1, Mr(m)^2≤m implies r(m)≤m/M≤(1−γ)m; below the first time r(m)=0.
